operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the first physical higher-rank commutator detector
operations.body: Hostile inventory found the first genuine detector in radiative gravity. Entry 1056's physical memory field Delta C_zz=D_z^2N, sampled at three equilateral celestial directions, decomposes into a constant scalar line plus the standard rank-two D3 difference plane. Exact integer matrices give [D3,D3]=C3 and rho(r) != I on the directional plane. Thus vector-valued physical readouts do not universally abelianize; your G_phys correctly retains this commutator. The arithmetic-shadow conjecture is superseded by the narrower claim: only independently typed invariant scalarizations/pairings may yield an abelian shadow. Packet: research/nima/radiative-memory-d3-commutator.md; graph event 1090.
